name: The Mentalist
overview: Patrick Jane, a former celebrity psychic, reads people instead of minds to close the California Bureau's hardest cases — while hunting the killer who took his family.

name: How I Met Your Mother
overview: A father tells his kids, in very long flashback, how he met their mother — with five best friends, a lot of bars and one blue French horn.

name: Monk
overview: A brilliant San Francisco detective with crippling OCD solves impossible cases while chasing the one murder he can't close: his wife's.

name: The Last Kingdom
overview: Born a Saxon, raised a Dane, Uhtred fights to reclaim his birthright as England is forged out of warring kingdoms.

name: Modern Family
overview: Three interconnected households, one hilariously chaotic extended family, filmed like a documentary nobody agreed to.

name: Seinfeld
overview: A stand-up comic and three spectacularly self-absorbed friends navigate nothing at all in nineties New York.

name: Columbo
overview: The rumpled detective everyone underestimates, asking one more question until the killer convicts himself.

name: The 100
overview: A failing orbital ark sends a hundred teenage delinquents to a radioactive Earth to find out if anyone can survive there.

name: The Flash
overview: A CSI investigator wakes from a lightning-strike coma with superhuman speed and a city that suddenly needs him.

name: Orange Is the New Black
overview: A comfortable New Yorker trades her life for a women's prison, where the inmates rewrite what family and justice mean.

name: The Vampire Diaries
overview: Two vampire brothers, one girl who looks exactly like the woman they loved in 1864, and a town with too many secrets.

name: True Detective
overview: Anthology crime stories across multiple timelines, where the investigation slowly unravels the detectives themselves.

name: Star vs. the Forces of Evil
overview: An intergalactic warrior princess moves in with a suburban family and brings her magic wand, and its villains, with her.

name: Doctor Who
overview: A 900-year-old Time Lord with two hearts saves planets for a living, usually with an ordinary companion in tow.

name: Family Guy
overview: The Griffin family of Quahog, plus a talking dog and a matricidal baby genius, in relentless non-sequitur comedy.

name: Supernatural
overview: Two brothers drive a '67 Impala across America hunting demons, ghosts and everything their father taught them to kill.

name: Criminal Minds
overview: The FBI's Behavioural Analysis Unit profiles killers before they strike again, and pays the price for living inside their heads.

name: Broadchurch
overview: A boy's murder turns a small coastal town inside out, and the media circus that follows does the rest.

name: Arthur
overview: An eight-year-old aardvark, his friends and family, and the small dramas that feel enormous at that age.

name: Project Hail Mary
overview: A science teacher wakes on a spaceship light years from home with no memory, and one job: figure out why the sun is dying.

name: Wildwood
overview: Two kids step into an enchanted forest to rescue a stolen baby brother from a murder of crows and the woman who commands them.

name: Apocalypse Z: New World
overview: Europe's last refuge sends a supply mission to the infected mainland, and the crew's loyalties fracture faster than the mission.

name: Coco
overview: A boy who dreams of music crosses into the Land of the Dead to find the truth about his family's ban on it.

name: A Story of Derry
overview: Centuries before Pennywise, three children walk into the Western Wood and meet something ancient that should have stayed asleep.

name: Heart of the Beast
overview: After a plane crash, a Special Forces officer and his combat dog fight the Alaskan wilderness — and each other's despair.

name: The Mongoose
overview: A disgraced war hero leads police on a televised cross-country chase, with his old battalion and the whole country rooting for him.

name: Pinocchio: Unstrung
overview: A wooden boy takes a very literal route to becoming real, one piece at a time, egged on by a sinister cricket.

name: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
overview: A prince and princess, a marriage, an exile — the opening chapter of the oldest epic in the world, reimagined at scale.

name: Primetime
overview: In 2006 a TV host chases ratings by catching predators on camera, until a sting goes fatally wrong.

name: Insidious: Out of the Further
overview: A young mother discovers she can walk into The Further — and bring back what lives there.

name: Godzilla Minus Zero
overview: Two years after war reduced Japan to zero, the country claws back a fragile peace — and then the new threat arrives.

name: The Fix
overview: Disgraced ex-CIA operatives take one last job in Tehran, chasing the score that could buy back their lives.

name: Clayface
overview: A Gotham street kid turned Hollywood star is disfigured, and the treatment that restores his face takes his mind with it.

name: Surviving Hurricane Otis
overview: Two estranged brothers fight to stay alive when a category-five hurricane swallows Acapulco.

name: Avengers: Doomsday
overview: Heroes from three universes are set on a collision course with an existential threat unlike anything they have faced.

name: Toy Story 5
overview: Bonnie gets a tablet, the toys get sidelined, and Woody and Buzz go head to head with the newest threat to playtime.

name: Street Fighter
overview: Ryu and Ken are dragged back into combat for the World Warrior Tournament, where the real fight is a conspiracy.

name: Runner
overview: A medical delivery turns into a cartel manhunt, and a former soldier has one night to get the cargo to a dying girl.

name: Mutiny
overview: Framed for his billionaire boss's murder, a man boards a cargo ship on a one-man revenge mission and finds a conspiracy.

name: Practical Magic 2
overview: The Owens sisters come back to the family curse that has been waiting patiently to finish what it started.

name: Sense and Sensibility
overview: Two sisters, one governed by feeling and one by sense, navigate love, money and reputation in a world built against them.

name: You Can See Everything
overview: Thirty-four days before prison, a notorious founder invites a sceptical film crew to document everything. It takes three years.

name: Gajab Raat
overview: One act of mercy toward an injured girl drags a corrupt cop into a single night that will cost him everything.

name: The Evil Dress
overview: A divorcee and her daughter move into an old house where a blue dress connects them to a ghost that will not let go.

name: Other Mommy
overview: A little girl befriends the thing in her house that looks exactly like her mother, and it wants to be her mother.

name: Mickey's Slayhouse
overview: Teenagers break into an abandoned theme park and find the mascots never really left.

name: Ali G: Who Iz I?
overview: Twenty years of chilling later, Ali G learns he is about to be a dad and heads to America to reclaim his glory.
